name: @ademkao/runnerctl
description: Manage GitHub Actions self-hosted runners on macOS and Linux with agent-friendly automation.

scripts.prepack: bash -n runnerctl && bash -n runnerctl-base && bash -n runnerctl-base-legacy && bash -n bin/runnerctl && bash -n bin/runnerctl-legacy && bash -n bin/runnerctl-cleanup && bash -n bin/runnerctl-host && bash -n bin/runnerctl-ci && bash -n bin/runnerctl-hooks && bash -n bin/runnerctl-queue && bash -n bin/runnerctl-queue-legacy && bash -n bin/runnerctl-scheduler && bash -n bin/runnerctl-scheduler-core && bash -n install.sh && bash -n install-legacy.sh && node --check npm/runnerctl.js
